name: Ramesh Kumar
content: Dr. Sumanth's care transformed my asthma management. The hospital staff is caring and the facilities are excellent. Highly recommended for lung-related issues.

name: Lakshmi Devi
content: My father received outstanding COPD treatment. Clear explanations, timely follow-ups, and genuine compassion. Sri Srinivasa Hospital is a blessing for Badvel.

name: Suresh Babu
content: When I was critically ill with severe pneumonia, the ICU team saved my life. Professional, modern care right here in Badvel.

name: Anitha Reddy
content: Video consultation was seamless. I got expert advice without traveling. Prescription and follow-up were perfectly handled.

name: Venkatesh Naidu
content: Sleep medicine guidance here was life-changing. I finally sleep well and feel energetic during the day.

name: Padma Sree
content: Our child's breathing issues improved dramatically under Dr. Sumanth. Kind doctor, clean hospital, trustworthy care.
